Mining Period: November 26, 2026 at 12:00 (UTC) – December 10, 2026 at 12:00 (UTC)

Eligible users who set up and complete recurring bStock purchases during the Promotion Period may qualify to receive rewards from a total prize pool of 50 SPCXB in token vouchers, capped at 0.01 SPCXB per user.
Users must achieve a cumulative conversion volume of at least 75 USDC equivalent through Binance Convert Recurring within the Promotion Period to be eligible for rewards.
Promotion Period: 2026-11-26 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-23 23:59 (UTC). Each day is a 24-hour period from 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 (UTC).

Gate Launchpool is set to launch project #388: XAUT (Tether Gold). Users can stake USDT, GT, or XAUT to share 42 XAUT tokens for free. Airdrop rewards are distributed hourly.
Total Staking Rewards: 42 XAUT
Introduction: Tether Gold (XAUt) is a product developed to combine the benefits of physical and digital assets by allowing its holders to own physical gold in the form of a digital token.
Website: https://gold.tether.to/
X: https://x.com/tethergold
Gate Labs did not invest in XAUT (Tether Gold).

Gate Launchpool is an innovative staking airdrop platform where users can earn hourly airdrops of trending and newly listed tokens by staking GT, BTC, ETH, GUSD, USDT or other tokens. With low entry barriers and high APR, it’s an easy way to capture market opportunities.
November 26, 2026
With bStock recurring transactions, eligible users can:
Automate purchases of supported bStocks at a preferred schedule.
Start small, with purchases from as little as 0.01 USDC equivalent.
Access fractional exposure to supported US shares through tokenized securities.
Trade 24/7 on Binance, subject to product and market availability.
During the Promotion Period, the first 5,000 eligible users* who fulfill all of the following criteria will be able to participate and equally share a reward pool of 50 SPCXB in token vouchers:
Register their participation via the promotion landing page;
Keep their Convert Recurring Plan active/ongoing throughout the Promotion Period.
Any conversions executed before the user has registered their participation will not count toward this Promotion.
*Eligible users refer to users who trade via Binance Convert Recurring with new plans created during the Promotion Period and have completed all the aforementioned criteria listed in the Promotion.
Trading volume may be accumulated across multiple newly created bStock plans during the Promotion Period.
If multiple users have the same qualifying transaction time, rankings will be determined by transaction volume. Users with higher total eligible converted volume will rank higher.
Only Binance Convert trades completed via Recurring mode will count as successful trades for this Promotion.

Eligible participants’ Convert Recurring Plan must remain active/ongoing throughout the entire Promotion Period. If a user pauses or cancels their plan at any time during the Promotion Period, the trade amount from that plan will no longer count toward reward calculation.
